LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerAnchorHarness.label: gatebreaker anchor harness
LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerAnchorHarness.description: A visible recoil-anchor rig worn over the Gatebreaker carapace. Its diagonal breach straps, hip anchors and compact pressure core lock the wearer into each heavy shot, turning the armor into a human-scale firing brace rather than a simple suit of protection.
LanguageData.ABY_NullCantorFocusSling.label: null cantor focus sling
LanguageData.ABY_NullCantorFocusSling.description: A cross-body focus sling for null acolytes and chant-rifle operators. Its cloth-wrapped conductor strap, suspended sigil coil and small calculation keys keep the Null Cantor steady while also isolating the wearer from the worst ritual feedback.
LanguageData.ABY_NullProcessionVeil.label: null procession veil
LanguageData.ABY_NullProcessionVeil.description: A rigid null-procession half-mask worn beneath a cowl rather than a cloth veil. The faceplate seals the acolyte's lower field of vision behind a small sigil filter, muting hostile whispers at the cost of a slight loss of ordinary target tracking.
